Chapter 705 - 705 Life Path; Second Baby!

Chapter 705 - 705 Life Path; Second Baby!

705 Life Path; Second Baby!

Lin Chengzhen pondered for a moment.

“Is that forbidden area really special?”

Li Hao knew that Lin Chengzhen was interested and immediately said, “I can guarantee it! It’s definitely special!”

After saying that, he put his hand on Lin Chengzhen’s shoulder and strode away.

…

In the blink of an eye, half a month had passed.

In the Coiling Dragon Villa.

Suddenly, someone knocked on the door.

When Lin Fan heard that, he opened his eyes and saw Hu Tian outside.

He could not help but feel puzzled. ‘They wouldn’t disturb me when I’m cultivating.

‘Did something happen?’

Lin Fan’s figure flashed and appeared in front of Hu Tian. He asked, “Did something happen?”

“Chengzhen is gone,” Hu Tian said.

Her voice was filled with worry.

Hu Tian did not want to disturb Lin Fan’s cultivation.

However, Lin Chengzhen had not gone to school or come home for half a month.

He was not answering his calls, and they could not locate it.

It was as if he had disappeared.

How could Hu Tian not be anxious?

When Lin Fan heard this, his mind power that was like a tidal wave immediately covered the entire Earth.

Soon, he saw two teenagers being chased by thousands of strange beasts in a cave.

One of the youths was Lin Chengzhen!

“Is this the special secret realm you mentioned?” Lin Chengzhen asked.

Li Hao stammered, “This… There are so many exotic beasts. Isn’t this special? See if you can find another place with so many exotic beasts to train at?”

When he relaxed, a wolf-like exotic beast almost grabbed his back. He was so scared that he sped up again.

“Run!”

…

Seeing this, Lin Fan retracted his spirit energy slowly.

“Don’t worry, Chengzhen is fine. He’ll be back in a few days.”

With Lin Fan’s current strength, all he needed to do was to blow out a single breath and he would be able to turn those thousands of beasts into ashes.

However, he did not do that.

That was because Lin Chengzhen had the Heavenly Protection Pearl on him.

On the entire Earth, other than Lin Fan, no one else could hurt Lin Chengzhen.

Not to mention thousands of exotic beasts.

He could use these thousands of exotic beasts to train Lin Chengzhen a little.

When Hu Tian heard Lin Fan’s answer, she immediately felt at ease.

As long as Lin Fan said it, Lin Chengzhen would definitely be fine.

…

Summer Region, Sky Thunder Star’s Life Tablet Hall.

Many important disciples, elders, and others used special methods to refine memorial tablets here.

Once a memorial tablet broke, it meant that the other party was dead.

A crisp sound rang out in the originally calm Life Tablet Hall.

A disciple hurried over. When he saw that the broken memorial tablet contained Xing Baokun’s name, his pupils constricted as he quickly ran out.

This matter very quickly alarmed the entire Sky Thunder Sect.

The Sky Thunder Sect was without a doubt the most powerful faction on the Sky Thunder Planet. In fact, it was also a famous major faction in the entire Summer Region.

The Universe level was extremely precious to the sect.

A few years ago, when Xing Baokun was cursed, Sect Master Lu Qinghong had predicted this outcome.

Now that his memorial tablet was broken, it was within expectations.

Lu Qinghong held a grand funeral for Xing Baokun. At the same time, he publicly announced that he would investigate Xing Baokun’s death at all costs and avenge him.

However, there was not a single mission to investigate Xing Baokun’s death in the Mission Hall of the Sky Thunder Sect.

All of a sudden, the discussion regarding Xing Baokun’s death was in full swing in the Sky Thunder Sect.

There were very few people who actually investigated.

This was also the result that Lu Qinghong wanted to see.

That was because he did not know how powerful the person who killed and cursed Xing Baokun was, nor did he know how powerful the force behind that person was.

After all, that was a curse that even the Grand Elder was helpless against.

…

Time flowed like water. In the blink of an eye, ten years had passed.

In the past ten years, Lin Fan had obtained a total of six Immortal Crystals from the system. He also received Top-Notch Water Law Talent, two Beginner Rule Upgrade Gems, two Transcendence Golden Bodies, and three Emperor-grade equipment.

With these treasures and his hard work, his cultivation level had reached level-nine Domain Lord, just a step away from the Universe level.

At the same time, his Yin Laws and Yang Laws had both reached the intermediate level.

Lin Fan willed himself and entered the River of Time once more.

He walked on the yin path, yang path, space path, and other paths, comprehending them for a while.

Then, he switched to the life path.

Right now, Lin Fan’s speed on the path of the life element was clearly much easier.

When he reached 200 meters, Lin Fan was already struggling.

“Huh? You can walk that far?” A crisp voice rang out behind him.

When Lin Fan heard that, he turned around.

It was Kathleen, whom he had met on the life path previously.

Lin Fan did not know if it was because of the increase in his cultivation state or because he had obtained Heavenly Eye, but he could now see Kathleen’s face clearly.

It was an exquisite and flawless face.

With just a glance, he was unable to extricate himself.

“You have a pretty good innate talent in the life element. What’s your name?” Kathleen asked.

“Lin Fan.”

Lin Fan did not hide his name.

There was no need.

“Lin Fan?” Kathleen repeated. “I have some ways to use the laws of life here. You can practice them.”

She pointed at Lin Fan.

Lin Fan wanted to dodge, but it was too late.

In an instant, all sorts of cultivation techniques related to the Life Laws appeared in Lin Fan’s mind. It was extremely mystical.

Lin Fan said, “Thank you.”

“It’s just a casual act,” Kathleen said. “I look forward to your achievements in the Life Laws.”

After saying that, she continued walking forward.

After Lin Fan had comprehended the Life Attribute Skill, the pressure around him had decreased by quite a bit.

Thus, he continued to walk forward for another ten meters and retreated from the River of Time.

Lin Fan heaved out a sigh of relief. The energy in his body had increased again.

At this moment, hurried footsteps sounded outside the door.

Huang Ling, Su Ningjing, and the others ran over anxiously.

Lin Fan’s face was filled with doubt. With a flash, he appeared right in front of them and asked, “What happened?”

As he spoke, he raised his head… He used Heavenly Eye to look up into the sky, but he did not find anything unusual.

“Ziqian is going to give birth!” Huang Ling said.

She was going to give birth!

Hu Tian took three years to give birth to Lin Chengzhen.

Although Qiu Ziqian was pregnant, her stomach had not grown.

In the past ten years, everyone had often comforted her.

Now, she was finally going to give birth.

Lin Fan’s mind power surged out like a tide.

Soon, he locked onto a bedroom in a villa at the back.

At this moment, Qiu Ziqian was lying on the bed with a round belly.

She was really going to give birth!

Lin Fan’s body flashed and he appeared beside Qiu Ziqian.

When Qiu Ziqian saw him, a blissful smile appeared on her face. She said softly, “Lin Fan, our baby is about to be born.”

Lin Fan said, “It’s been hard on you.”
